items.title: Help centre and contact support
items.text: Search the help from anywhere and reach support from inside Verdynt/OS.

items.title: Bring your data with you
items.text: Upload what your old system or spreadsheets export, such as customers, pass holders, products, staff and the rental fleet. Verdynt/OS matches the columns, flags duplicates and problems, and shows you a preview before anything is saved.

items.title: Partner passes
items.text: Record Indy Pass and reciprocal pass visits at the window and see them in your reports.

items.title: Accounting export
items.text: Send each day's sales to QuickBooks Online or Xero instead of typing them in.

items.title: Tickets in Apple and Google Wallet
items.text: Guests add their ticket or pass to their phone's wallet and scan it at the lift.

items.title: Season pass payment plans
items.text: Sell a pass with a deposit and monthly payments, taken automatically.

items.title: Help assistant
items.text: Ask a question in plain words and get the steps for this screen.

items.title: This season against last
items.text: Visits, sales, lessons and incidents side by side with the same day last season.

items.title: Visitor forecast
items.text: How busy the next 10 days will be, as a range, from the day of the week, holidays and school breaks, new snow, the weather forecast and tickets already sold online. It suggests crew sizes, rental and lesson staffing, and says why in plain words. Verdynt/OS already writes down each day’s weather, snow, visits and sales every night, so the forecast starts with your own history.

items.title: Snow report that writes itself
items.text: Each morning, the day's conditions update for your website, email and social media, written from lifts, trails, grooming, new snow and weather. You check it and post it.

items.title: Morning brief for managers
items.text: One short read each morning: yesterday against last year, today's forecast and staffing gaps, lifts on hold, open work orders and open incidents.

items.title: Patrol report check and spoken reports
items.text: Before a patient care report is submitted, Verdynt/OS points out anything missing or that doesn't add up. Patrollers can speak what happened and Verdynt/OS fills in the fields it can. It only suggests; the patroller and director decide.

items.title: Ask your data and your documents
items.text: Ask in plain words, like "How did lessons do this February against last?" or "What does our lift evacuation plan say about the double chair?"

items.title: Suggested replies to guests
items.text: A drafted answer to each guest message or email, for staff to edit and send.

items.title: Payroll export, and café and retail totals
items.text: Hours out to your payroll, and food and retail sales into Money.

items.title: Drop a pin for hazards and equipment
items.text: Mark a hazard or a piece of equipment on the map from where you stand.

items.title: Satellite map view
items.text: Aerial imagery under your trail map.

items.title: One login for groups of mountains
items.text: Move between mountains you work at without signing in again.

items.title: Connect your other systems
items.text: An API and event notifications for the tools you already use.

items.title: Suggested prices
items.text: Price ideas for busy and quiet days, based on how fast tickets are selling.
